about: Lane R1's --selftest-router-bench, as merged, building the bench's questions (the standard library, General left out; binders by what goes here and their titles, or by their titles alone; agents by what each is for, then nobody), before lane R2 moved that construction into BindersKit. Each hash is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of Tev1Prompt.prompt(question), in lowercase hex. Everything in the bench is made up.
